integrity: Proof is analytic; 28,300 deterministic finite checks and 700,000 sampled directions are corroboration rather than substitutes for the asymptotic proof. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Real ambient dimension three, Haar-uniform rank-one orientation, and the intermediate diagonal Gram solve only; no claim about full tangent-projector stability, forward finite-precision error, or higher-dimensional conditioning.
title: A logarithmically enhanced Haar conditioning tail for the rank-one factor-analysis tangent solve
